_about: Genre-tagged World Kit content for Braid (labels, equipment, threats). An entry may carry several genre tags; content.py <genres> lists what a mix draws from, the first genre's entries first, with the era bans of story_gen.py applied. A starting point the GM rewrites for the world. All text is our own.
